text: What did the stranger want at the stable?
why: A plain question the story has given reason to ask: a stranger appeared at night near the stables and Edith Baxter has just been stopped by him.

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — find the way
why: The stranger has just asked "Can you tell me where I am?" and said he was lost on the moor, so finding the way is a possibility the story has already raised.
